cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.description: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

cards.name: Sceptile
cards.description: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

cards.name: Celesteela
cards.description: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

cards.name: Kartana
cards.description: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.description: With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts indiscriminately. This is because of the stress it feels at being unable to fly.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.description: With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts indiscriminately. This is because of the stress it feels at being unable to fly.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.description: They lurk deep within caves—motionless, neither eating nor drinking. Why they don't die is not known.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.description: It flies around on its wings, which have grown in at last. In its happiness, it gushes hot flames, burning up the fields it passes over.

cards.name: Latias ◇
cards.description: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

cards.name: Latios ◇
cards.description: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.description: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.description: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.description: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they're circling, the ocean is sure to be teeming with fish Pokémon.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.description: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.description: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.description: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.description: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

cards.name: Whismur
cards.description: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

cards.name: Whismur
cards.description: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

cards.name: Loudred
cards.description: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

cards.name: Exploud
cards.description: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor—or like an earthquake has struck.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.description: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.description: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.description: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

cards.name: Kecleon
cards.description: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.description: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.description: When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its head. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.description: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

cards.name: Volbeat
cards.description: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

cards.name: Illumise
cards.description: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.description: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.description: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.description: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.description: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.description: The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokémon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.description: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.description: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.description: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.description: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Combusken
cards.description: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.description: If the fire burning within its shell goes out, it will die. Those who wish to raise one in their home must always keep something flammable at hand.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.description: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.description: This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its passionate dance moves cause its enemies to combust in both body and mind.

cards.name: Mudkip
cards.description: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Mudkip
cards.description: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Marshtomp
cards.description: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.

cards.name: Swampert
cards.description: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.description: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.description: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.description: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.description: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.description: Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.

cards.name: Clamperl
cards.description: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.

cards.name: Huntail
cards.description: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

cards.name: Gorebyss
cards.description: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.description: Loving couples have a soft spot for this Pokémon, so honeymoon hotels often release this Pokémon into their pools.

cards.name: Regice
cards.description: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.description: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.description: Some fishermen weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.description: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.description: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.description: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.description: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

cards.name: Minun
cards.description: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.description: It creates an electric charge by rubbing its feathers together. It dances over to its enemies and delivers shocking electrical punches.

cards.name: Gulpin
cards.description: There is nothing its stomach can't digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.

cards.name: Swalot
cards.description: It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.description: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.description: It spins thread from both its rear and its mouth. Then it wraps its prey up in thread and sips their bodily fluids at its leisure.

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.description: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.description: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.description: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.description: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.description: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

cards.name: Banette
cards.description: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.description: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.description: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.description: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.description: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

cards.name: Lunala
cards.description: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.description: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.description: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.description: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.description: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.description: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.description: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.description: It is said that it originates from clay dolls made by an ancient civilization.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.description: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

cards.name: Regirock
cards.description: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.description: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

cards.name: Minior
cards.description: Strong impacts can knock it out of its shell. This Pokémon was born from mutated nanoparticles.

cards.name: Alolan Rattata
cards.description: When the sun goes down, it becomes active. It runs around town on a chase for good food for the boss of its nest—Raticate.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: It uses its claws to poke holes in eggs so it can slurp out the insides. Breeders consider it a scourge and will drive it away or eradicate it.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.description: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.description: It chews its way through boulders with its sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the darkness underground.

cards.name: Grovyle
cards.description: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.description: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.description: With magnetic traction, it pulls its opponents in close. When they're in range, it slashes them with its rear claws.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.description: With magnetic traction, it pulls its opponents in close. When they're in range, it slashes them with its rear claws.

cards.name: Metang
cards.description: It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.description: A linkage of two Metang, this Pokémon can perform any calculation in a flash by utilizing parallel processing in its four brains.

cards.name: Registeel
cards.description: Its body is said to be harder than any kind of metal. A study has revealed that its body is hollow.

cards.name: Jirachi ◇
cards.description: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Solgaleo
cards.description: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.
